note: Visual-composition outcome corpus for the consumer chat (FIX-DS-06.02, finding DS-06/XD-13; sibling of fix-ds-06.01.json — the quiet dashboard). The same two judged layers stay SEPARATE: routing/constraint/provenance correctness is judged deterministically on artifacts here; the VISUAL outcome is judged by an independent render rubric against the actual render at the same viewport and content — that live model/render eval is a SEPARATE authorized execution batch after implementation, which no fixture task imitates. A correct render is NOT obliged to change; a mechanical PASS never substitutes for composition judgement; a fault names a region and what is wrong, never only a token/style name; a claimed screenshot must EXIST as a decodable file (a mention is not a file); an offline/no-keys route reports NOT_RUN and proposes no install; 100% structural PASS is never phrased as a proven design improvement — comparison stays UNMEASURED until the authorized run (identical inputs/budget/viewports, blind order, repeated samples, failures/cost/time recorded).

prompt.text: Review an already-correct consumer chat screen (tokens clean, bubbles aligned, input bar reachable). Identity-preserving: a correct render is NOT obliged to change — record kept/changed per region with a reason into chat-review.md; zero changes with reasons is a valid outcome.

Stress the chat's message list at viewport 390x844 with the SAME content fixture both arms use: a 40-message burst, one 2000-character message, an emoji-only message, and a URL that cannot wrap. Write message-stress.md naming the faults on the actual render — a fault names a region and what is wrong, never only a token/style name.

Judge the chat input bar and its actions for one-hand reach at 390x844 (thumb zone), with the keyboard OPEN — the composition question no token check answers. Write reach-review.md; a mechanical token PASS does not close this review.

Review the consumer chat WITHOUT any screenshot or render available: every claim that needs the render is marked NOT_RUN (what it would take), and no screenshot path is cited as existing. Write render-review.md.

Check the chat's dark theme against the light one at the same viewport and content: every bubble/status/link pair keeps contrast and the second cue; parity faults name the region and both values. Write theme-parity.md.
